name: Design and describe character clothing
description: Users asked to design, describe, or critique specific outfits, costumes, and clothing items for fictional characters, historical figures, or personal styling. The requests ranged from creating detailed character wardrobes for anime or sci-fi narratives to providing fashion advice, historical accuracy checks, and catalog entries for niche or fictional apparel trends.
